_why: The plugin exists three times (repo source, ~/.cheaper/marketplace/..., and Claude Code's plugin cache) and the cache directory is named after the version in plugin.json. Editing a file without bumping that version leaves the copy that actually runs stale at the same path with no signal. This manifest pins the tree to its declared version; cli/test/inject_tagline.test.js fails until both are updated together. See the versioning section of README.md.
_digest: sha256 over every shipped file, sorted by relative path, hashing '<relpath>\0<sha256-of-bytes>\n' per file. Excluded: this manifest, and Claude Code's .in_use/<pid> runtime lockfiles — so an INSTALLED copy hashes identically to the source and can be verified in place.
